notes: Group totals and total are as printed in the section 9 Production Cost table (RM/t FFB). That table's column is headed 'Actual 5 M', but the figures are the 11-month (May 2025–Mar 2026) amounts divided by 30,841.09 t (e.g. general charges RM2,738,734 / 30,841.09 = 88.80), so the period is 11 months; '5 M' is a mislabel.

Harvest & collection and upkeep items are the whole-ringgit RM/t printed in the section 7 and section 6 tables; they add to 98 (budget 84) and 108 (budget 137) because of rounding. Section 7 prints the harvest group total as RM99/t vs RM85/t; section 9 gives 98.57 vs 85.23.
Upkeep 'Other (5 items)' = leaf sampling labour, leaf sampling material, supplying, manuring contract and soil/water conservation, calc as RM amount / FFB.

General-charge items are calc: section 5 RM amount / 30,841.09 t actual FFB; budget = full-year budget RM / 29,746 t (the to-date budget FFB the report prints), which is how the report reaches RM96.99. The 13 largest of 42 lines are shown; the other 29 are summed. Items reproduce the printed 88.80 and 96.99. Depreciation (RM855,739) and amortisation (RM731,659) are excluded, as in the section 9 total.
Budgets in the cost tables are full-year (12-month) budgets divided by the to-date budget FFB, so actual vs budget per tonne is not like-for-like. Cost per tonne CPO: RM1,469 vs RM1,565 budget.

summary: FY2026/27 has started weakly: May–Jul 2026 yield 3.83 t/ha vs 5.50 a year earlier (-30%); every field down 27–38% except rehab field 11B (Agro).
FY2025/26 was strong: 20.81 t/ha vs 16.62 (+25%, Agro); to Mar 2026 30,841 t FFB, 19.19 t/ha vs 18.51 budget (PA).
Cost RM294.96/t FFB vs RM318.92 budget (May 2025–Mar 2026); harvesting RM98.57/t is 16% over budget (Sunday/holiday pay, tractor costs).
FY2026/27 fertiliser only 32% applied by July 2026 (56% delivered); circle spraying 53%, inter-row 27%, progressive pruning 69%.
Harvesters adequate (112 vs 107) but sprayers short (10 vs 16); harvester output low (about 6 hours worked, 74% outturn) and spraying quality poor.

issues.title: FY2024/25 yield 16.62 t/ha: 11 months (PA) or 12 months (Agro)
issues.detail: PA section 8 gives last year's same period (May 2024–Mar 2025, 11 months) as 26,705.49 t = 16.62 t/ha, and 8.2 compares 19.19 with it. Agro Table 15 gives 16.62 t/ha as the full FY2024/25 yield (Period 12, to Apr 2025). The same figure cannot be both; if the Agro figure is really 11 months, the +25% FY2025/26 gain (20.81 vs 16.62) is overstated.

issues.title: Agro Table 16 FY2025/26 total 5.50 t/ha does not match its fields
issues.detail: Agro Table 16 (May–Jul): field yields for FY2025/26 (6.45, 6.09, 6.48, 5.70, 4.81, 5.47, 4.92, 6.12, 1.35) area-weighted give 5.72 t/ha, not the printed 5.50. The other totals in Tables 15 and 16 (16.62, 20.81, 3.83) do reproduce. With 5.72 the FY2026/27 decline is -33%, not -30% as stated in 5.8 and the summary.

issues.title: Selective spraying 100% (PA) vs 1.7 rounds (Agro)
issues.detail: PA 6.3.1 says 3,214 ha (2 rounds), 100% of budget, done to Mar 2026, but its own table shows A13 70%, B15 129%, B17 75% and the block hectares listed sum to only 1,432.36 ha per round (B-block areas are about half the field areas), i.e. about 2,865 ha for 2 rounds. Agro Table 12 gives FY2025/26 inter-row spraying of 2,654.10 ha, average 1.7 rounds.

issues.title: Circle spraying 100% (PA) vs 1.9 rounds (Agro)
issues.detail: PA 6.2.1: 3,214.24 ha, 2 rounds, 100% to Mar 2026. Agro Table 11 FY2025/26: 3,127.25 ha, 1.9 rounds; 05A 1.7, 05B 1.9 and 11B 1.8 rounds did not reach the target.

issues.title: Capital expenditure group totals wrong
issues.detail: PA section 11: Tractor & Trailers total printed RM48,400 but items are RM28,500 + RM48,400 = RM76,900. Furniture & Fittings total printed RM1,600 but items add to RM7,040. Grand total RM158,750 adds the wrong subtotals; with the item figures it would be RM192,690 (budget RM967,950).

issues.title: Production cost table labelled 'Actual 5 M' (is 11 months)
issues.detail: PA section 9 column header reads 'Actual 5 M', but the report's period is May 2025–Mar 2026 and the figures reproduce only on 11-month amounts: general charges RM2,738,734 / 30,841.09 t = 88.80; upkeep RM3,318,268.71 / 30,841.09 = 107.59; harvesting RM3,040,092 / 30,841.09 = 98.57 (sections 5–7 are all headed 11M). The label should read 'Actual 11 M'.

issues.title: Agro Table 15 period: February or April 2026
issues.detail: Agro 5.1 text says yield comparison 'as February 2026 (Period 12)'; Table 15 heading says 'as at April 2026 (Period 12)'. Period 12 of a May–Apr year is April.

issues.title: Pruning progress: 69% (PA) vs 227% (Agro) for FY2025/26
issues.detail: PA 6.6.1: 2,202.76 of 3,214.28 ha progressively pruned to Mar 2026 (69%), yet the PA calls pruning satisfactory. Agro Table 9 shows FY2025/26 progressive pruning 426,303 palms vs 188,087 programmed (227%) to Apr 2026. Agro Table 9 corrective pruning actuals add to 16,803, not the printed 16,754.

issues.title: Palm counts differ between tables
issues.detail: PA Field Details total stand 200,321 vs PA pruning table 201,602; pruning table rows where rehab + normal palms do not equal total (A15 2,104 vs 2,106; A16 6,030 vs 6,034; A18 4,995 vs 5,019; A19 4,177 vs 4,183; B16 2,125 vs 2,167; B15 2,789 vs 2,947). Agro Table 3 census 200,715 palms but Agro Tables 9/10 'Total palm' column totals 184,509 (e.g. 04B 23,073 vs 30,460 in Table 3).

issues.title: Vehicle account type subtotals
issues.detail: PA section 10: Road team lorries type total RM308,135.00 vs listed vehicles RM389,076.09 (budget RM490,995 vs RM557,932); Bin type total RM57,378.21 omits lorry SYE2587 RM12,380.37; Road grader type total RM102,470.84 omits grader SS 435U RM47,134.98.

issues.title: PA small text/table slips
issues.detail: 6.7.5 says 2,335 MT crusher run vs '200 MT' budgeted; table shows 2,000 MT. 6.6.2 balance 35.39 ha (175.24 - 139.81 = 35.43). 3.3 says sprayers short by 4 (Apr 2026) vs table short 6 (16 required, 10 available).

issues.title: Rainfall: PA and Agro monthly figures differ
issues.detail: PA Appendix 1 (calendar columns, no year headings) vs Agro Table 17: Jan 2018 160 vs 151 mm; Dec 2019 316 vs 315 mm; Mar 2022 rain days 18 vs 19; Apr 2023 151 vs 150.5 mm. Dashboard uses Agro FY totals, which add up.

issues.title: Cost per tonne CPO does not reproduce
issues.detail: PA section 9: total RM294.96/t FFB x 30,841.09 t FFB / 6,224.02 t CPO (section 8) = RM1,462/t CPO, not the printed RM1,469 (general charges 440 vs 442 printed; upkeep 533 vs 536; harvesting 488 vs 491). Printed figures imply about 6,193 t CPO. Budget column (RM1,565) does reproduce.

actions.item: Stop CKS for circle and selective spraying; use CDA for circles and mist blowers for woodies
Eradicate soft woodies, VOPs, lalang, Giant Paspalum and Hedyotis; respray poorly killed woodies
Spray selective inter-row before circles; avoid over-spraying; rotate herbicides
Chase supplier for remaining FY2026/27 fertiliser (56% delivered, 32% applied)
Raise sub-surface manuring output to 1 ha/man-day (25 bags) with pre-holing
Do not place fertiliser on terrace lips
Use old borate (150 g) and rock phosphate (1.5 kg) stock in P11-B17
Raise harvester productivity (8–9 hour day) and investigate 74% outturn
Improve supervision: zero unripe bunches and collect all loose fruit (B17, B01, B04, A05)
Catch up progressive pruning (69%) and add reopened B17 areas to corrective pruning
Continue palm thinning in close-planted, ravine and hilly areas (6,286 palms so far)
Gravel collection roads; consult Senior Manager on road improvement
Evaluate high tractor running costs; outsource internal transport
Rat census along jungle boundaries; bait if threshold reached
Carry out a palm census and base fertiliser on actual palm density

kb:
MLP 1 ESTATE (Millian Labau Plantation-1), United Malacca Berhad (UMB group). Fact pack from PA Report 1/2026 (Planting Advisor Mr. Boey Chee Weng, visit 4-5 May 2026, review period May 2025 to March 2026, financial year 2025/2026 which runs May to April) and Agronomy Report 2/2026 (En. Alison Bin Janari, Junior Agronomist, and Mr. Chong Kuan Ming, Senior Agronomist; visit 4 August 2026; previous Agro visit 11 February 2026; manuring programmes FY2026/27 and FY2027/28). Senior Manager Mr. Celestine Bin Siplis; Estate Manager En. Zamri Bin Md. Din.

AREA (PA section 2, as at March 2026; Agro Table 1): title 2,010.00 ha. Oil palm 1,607.14 ha, all mature (79.96% of title); coffee 2.00 ha. Non-cultivated 400.86 ha: building staff RO 4.47, building site 12.75, ravine/steep/hill 142.07, swamps/pond 2.27, main road 17.67, field road 221.63 ha (Agro groups roads as 239.30 ha and total unplanted 402.86 ha including coffee). No change in area; no more areas to rehabilitate (PA). All Felda material. Fields (Agro Table 2/3, ha and current SPH): 2004A 357.19 ha SPH 126 (A01, A02, A07, A08, A09, A10, A12); 2004B 222.75 ha SPH 137 (B01, B05, B06, B12); 2005A 201.81 ha SPH 131 (A03, A04, A06, A11); 2005B 224.65 ha SPH 125 (B07, B08, B09, B11, B13, B16); 2006A 175.83 ha SPH 117 (A05, A13, A14, A17); 2006B 175.97 ha SPH 128 (B02, B03, B10, B14); 2007A 163.86 ha SPH 104 (A15, A16, A18, A19); 2007B 45.09 ha SPH 102 (B04, B15); 2011B 39.99 ha SPH 155 (B17). Total stand 200,321 palms (PA pruning table gives 201,602), 125 SPH (PA); Agro census 200,715 palms, 125 SPH (07A up 2% and 11B up 3% after 2.00 ha of vacant land in P11B-17 was reopened when the land dispute was resolved). No recent palm census by the estate. Agro: SPH 125 is low; P06A, P07A, P07B under 120 SPH due to vacant hilly areas; P11B 155 SPH, closely planted. Palm thinning to August 2026 (Agro Table 4): 6,286 palms (04A 2,398; 04B 1,050; 05A 1,050; 05B 1,250; 06A 278; 06B 200; 07A 60).

LABOUR (PA section 3, March 2026): 215 workers vs 231 required (-16). FFB harvester/carrier 112 vs 107 (+5), ratio 1:14 ha (requirement 1:15), adequate. Tractor drivers 8/8, lorry bin 1/0, ramp attendant 2/2, manuring 16 vs 17 (-1), spraying 10 vs 16 (-6; text 3.3 says short of 4 as of April 2026), mandores harvest 6/6, spraying 1/1, manuring 2/2, general workers 8 vs 25 (-17), security 8 vs 9, road team lorry drivers 7 vs 6, machinery operators (road team) 7 vs 5, creche ayah 3 vs 4. Worker ratio 1:7 ha, justified because Regional Office workers are on the MLP 1 labour statement. PA: urgent to recruit sprayers as inter-rows are unsatisfactory.

STAFF (PA 4): 12 staff, unchanged, adequate.

GENERAL CHARGES (PA section 5, 11 months to March 2026, RM): FFB 30,841.09 t actual vs 29,746 t budget. Staff salary and related RM910,022 vs RM930,955 year budget (RM566 vs 579/ha); staff EPF +20% (increments, under-budgeted). Labour overhead RM863,055 vs RM890,536 (RM537 vs 554/ha): labour EPF RM108,798 vs RM50,798 (+114%, foreign worker EPF not budgeted), labour paid leave RM350,669 vs RM212,377 (+65%), upkeep lines/electricity/water +11% (quarters repairs), labour recruitment RM114,139 vs RM294,514 (-61%). Office and related RM914,650 vs RM1,009,841 (RM569 vs 628/ha): water/electricity RM420,216 vs RM527,516, cess/rate/rent RM116,313, general office +36% (PA and agronomist fees), licences +57% (genset and air compressor), subscriptions +16% (MEOA, MEF), transport and travelling +12% (bringing in new workers, staff to annual dinner in Malacca), weighbridge +55% (overtime, repairs). Premises upkeep RM46,249; misc RM4,757. Depreciation RM855,739 (budget 779,196), amortisation RM731,659. Grand total RM4,326,133 vs RM4,395,691 (RM2,692 vs 2,735/ha), underspent 2%. Note the budget column is the full-year budget compared with 11-month actuals.

UPKEEP AND CULTIVATION (PA section 6 table, May 2025 to March 2026): total RM3,318,268.71 vs RM4,066,380 budget; RM2,065/ha vs RM2,530/ha; RM108/t vs RM137/t; underspent 18%. Per ha actual vs budget: supervision 33 vs 35; weeding 63 vs 31 (+104%); selective spraying and lallang 138 vs 180; manuring labour 82 vs 88; material 935 vs 1,177 (RM1,503,283); transport 30 vs 124; pests and diseases 6 vs 26; census and thinning 10 vs 24; drains 11 vs 41; roads and bridges 588 vs 669 (RM944,616); boundaries 11 vs 11; pruning 150 vs 116 (+29%); tools 6 vs 5 (+37%).

CIRCLE SPRAYING (PA 6.2): 3,214.24 ha (2 rounds), 100% to March 2026; circles generally clean. CKS high-volume, 2.7 ha/man-day; piece rate RM23/ha, earnings RM62.10/day, below the RM65.38 basic wage. With CDA estates achieve more than 4.5 ha/man-day at RM16-18/ha. Glyphosate 0.71 L/ha (6 pumps/ha), 16 pumps/man-day. Circle raking recommended in older plantings. PA: stop using CKS, use CDA fully. Agro Table 11 FY2025/26: 3,127.25 ha, average 1.9 rounds (normal 1,584.18 ha, mist blower 1,543.07 ha); 05A 1.7, 05B 1.9, 11B 1.8 rounds below target.

SELECTIVE SPRAYING (PA 6.3): reported 3,214 ha (2 rounds) 100% to March 2026 (table shows A13 70%, B15 129%, B17 75%). Fewer soft woodies than last visit but VOPs, lalang, Giant Paspalum and Hedyotis remain; inter-rows messy; spraying quality unsatisfactory with missed and poorly killed woodies, respraying needed. CKS 2.8 ha/man-day at RM29.50/ha (earning RM79.65); mist blower 3.9 ha/man-day at RM20/ha (RM78). Ally 0.07 kg/ha (CKS, 7 pumps) and 0.11 kg/ha (mist blower, 2.75 pumps); 16 and 10 pumps/man-day. PA: use mist blowers only for woodies; CKS for VOPs as separate round. Agro Table 12 FY2025/26 inter-row: 2,654.10 ha, 1.7 rounds; VOP spraying 126.85 ha, wild banana 44.45 ha, woody poisoning 599.39 ha.

FY2026/27 WEEDING (Agro, to July 2026): circle spraying 850.41 ha, 53% (normal 16%, mist blower 37%), behind schedule due to chemical delivery; 07A and 11B 0%, 06A 27%. Circle raking 18,442 palms. Inter-row selective 429.99 ha, 27% (05B, 06A, 07B, 11B nil); VOP 16 ha, woody poisoning 164.6 ha.  Poor ground in P07A-14, P06A-13, P05B-09, P05-15; VOPs in circles in P05B-09; over-spraying in P04B-01, P06B-02, P06B-06. Agro: do selective inter-row before circles, rotate herbicides, improve timeliness, chemical availability and supervision.

MANURING (PA 6.4): FY2025/26 programme per block mostly Mix A 2.0, Mix B 2.0, Mix A 2.0, Mix B 2.0 kg/palm, plus RP 1.5 kg in 2005-2007 and 2011 plantings, kieserite 1.0 kg in A04, A11, A19, B11 and 2.0 kg in B10, B04; B17 rounds May-Aug 2025 not applied (land dispute), NK mix 2.5 kg applied Feb 2026. 6,958.12 of 7,452.26 ha applied (93%); rehabilitated areas not applied though budgeted. Broadcasting 16 bags/man-day (3.07 ha), RM21.50/ha, earning RM66/day. Sub-surface at P04/B5 done August 2025, 0.5 ha/man-day, 10 bags/ha, RM6/bag, RM60/day; benchmark 1 ha and 25 bags/man-day; pre-holing and FEHB 4-worker gang method advised. Agro Table 5 FY2025/26: Mix A 772.95 of 830.25 mt (93%), RP 164.3 of 187.26 (88%), Mix B 702.15 of 758.7 (93%), kieserite 34.65 of 39.53 (88%); total 1,674.05 of 1,815.74 mt (92%). Old borate and RP stocks to be used in P11-B17 (borate 150 g, RP 1.5 kg/palm). FY2026/27 to July 2026 (Agro Table 6): Mix B 84.55 of 182.39 mt (46%), Mix A 131.55 of 434.83 (30%), kieserite 0 of 49.73; total 216.1 of 666.95 mt (32%); only 56% of stock delivered (377.65 mt). Application check at P04A-B1 (Mix A 2.0 kg) acceptable, 16-17 bags/worker; do not apply on terrace lips. Store well kept.

FERTILISER PROGRAMME FY2026/27 (Agro Appendix 1, unchanged, kg/palm): 2004A, 2004B, 2005A, 2005B: Mix A 2.00 Jun-26, NK1 2.00 Sep-26, Mix A 2.00 Dec-26, NK 2.00 Mar-27; kieserite 1.00 Jul-26 in A06, A11, B09; B05 sub-soil 8.00 Jun-26 only. 2006A, 2006B, 2007A, 2007B: Mix B 2.00 May-26, Mix A 2.00 Aug-26, Mix B 2.00 Nov-26, Mix A 2.00 Feb-27; RP 1.50 Sep-26 in A17, B02 and all 2007; kieserite 1.00 Jun-26 in B10, A15, A16; B03 and B04 sub-soil 8.00 May-26 plus kieserite 1.00. 2011B: Mix B, Mix A, RP 1.50, Mix B, Mix B. FY2027/28 (Appendix 2): Mix A 2.00 x4 for 2004-2005 plantings; P04A-01 added to sub-soil (4.00 x2); B05 8.00 sub-soil; 2006-2011 Mix B, GML 2.0, NK1, Mix B, NK1 with RP 1.5 in 2007; B03 and B04 sub-soil 4.00 x2. Base requirements on actual palm density.

LEAF ANALYSIS (Agro Table 8): N mostly high (2.64-2.94%), P high (0.168-0.190%), K high (1.26-1.42%), Mg normal to high (0.23-0.32%), B normal (12.1-14.1 ppm); Ca low in every block (0.34-0.42%). Mg deficiency in hilly B11, B04, B09, B10, B15 has reduced. B17 still has thin trunks, yellowish fronds, small bunches.

PEST AND DISEASE: PA saw one Ganoderma palm (P06/B03, fruiting bodies); otherwise no issues. Agro: no new Ganoderma; localised rat damage along jungle boundaries, regular censuses and baiting at threshold.

PRUNING: PA 6.6: progressive pruning 2,202.76 of 3,214.28 ha to March (PA nonetheless rates it satisfactory); corrective pruning 139.81 of 175.24 ha rehab area, balance carried to FY2026/27, due October 2026; RM1/palm/year progressive, RM6/palm corrective; 13,751 rehab palms. Agro Table 9 FY2025/26 (to April): progressive 426,303 palms vs 188,087 programmed (227%), corrective 16,754 vs 13,751 (122%) as corrective area was underestimated; P06B and P11B not finished. Agro Table 10 FY2026/27 to July: progressive 135,647 of 195,788 (69%, behind; 07A 28%, 07B 35%, 11B 0%); corrective 5,363 of 5,279 (102%), P07A still in progress; new reopened B17 areas need corrective pruning. Canopy otherwise acceptable.

ROADS AND DRAINS (PA 6.7, 6.8): main road grading 1,504 of 2,273 chains at RM20.12/chain; existing road repair 66,938 m at RM2.25 vs 2.31/m; new harvesting road 8,934 m (444 chains) of 600 chains at RM3.00 vs 6.34; crusher run 2,335.74 MT (budget 2,000 MT) at RM25.10 vs 41.40/MT for patching; no gravelling done; many collection roads need gravel; rutted hilly roads; new foothill roads and a new bridge. Drains: no issues.

HARVESTING AND COLLECTION (PA section 7, to March 2026): RM3,040,092 vs RM2,535,128 year budget; RM1,892 vs 1,577/ha; RM99 vs 85/t (+20%). Supervision RM5/t (+14%, mandore incentives), harvesting RM61 vs 56/t (+13%, Sunday and public holiday double pay not budgeted), loose fruit RM1, infield loading RM4, ramp RM3, internal transport RM23 vs 18/t (+36%, high tractor costs, not outsourced), tools +189%. Rounds 26.1 vs 22 budget; interval averaged 15 days; outturn 74% (low, to be investigated); harvesters work only about 6 hours, should work 8-9. Uncollected loose fruit and old bunches seen (A08, A09, A18, B02, B17). Collection by wheelbarrow and crawlers. Harvest rate RM50/t: 2004 1.35 t/man-day earning RM67.50; 2005 1.26, RM63.00; 2006 1.33, RM66.50; 2007 1.75, RM87.50; 2011 0.93, RM46.50 (basic wage RM65.38). Agro Table 7: FY2025/26 intervals often up to 18-23 days; FY2026/27 mostly 9-18 days, some above 15; ramp crop quality acceptable but unripe bunches still a concern; loose fruit missed in P11B-17, P04B-01, P05B-04, P05A-05.

CROP (PA section 8, FY2025/26 to March 2026, 11 months): FFB 30,841.09 t vs 29,746 t budget to date (annual budget 33,120 t); last year same period 26,705.49 t. Yield 19.19 t/ha vs 18.51 budget (+4%) and 16.62 last year (+15%); annual budget 20.61 t/ha. FY2024/25 note: the PA treats 16.62 t/ha as the 11-month May 2024-Mar 2025 figure, while Agro Table 15 shows 16.62 as the full FY2024/25.
